app.title: Ankle Fracture Classification
app.description: Answer the questions to obtain the Lauge-Hansen, Danis-Weber, AO/OTA, and Bartonicek classification

landing.headline: Classify Ankle Fractures
landing.subheadline: Get instant Lauge-Hansen, Danis-Weber, AO/OTA, and Bartonicek classifications with our evidence-based algorithm.

features.title: Why Anklyze?
features.subtitle: Built for orthopedic surgeons who need accurate, fast fracture classification at the point of care.

accurate.title: Evidence-Based
accurate.description: Classifications derived from peer-reviewed literature and validated clinical algorithms.

fast.title: Instant Results
fast.description: Get comprehensive classifications in under 30 seconds with our guided questionnaire.

comprehensive.title: Four Systems
comprehensive.description: Lauge-Hansen, Danis-Weber, AO/OTA, and Bartonicek classifications in one tool.

free.title: Always Free
free.description: No subscription, no ads, no data collection. Just a tool that works.

chat.title: AI Chat
chat.description: Describe the fracture in natural language and let AI extract the classification parameters.

howItWorks.title: How It Works
howItWorks.subtitle: Three simple steps to accurate fracture classification

step1.title: Select Fracture Location
step1.description: Identify which malleoli are involved: medial, lateral, or posterior.

step2.title: Answer Guided Questions
step2.description: Our algorithm adapts to show only relevant questions based on your selections.

step3.title: Get Classification
step3.description: Receive detailed classifications with clinical notes and treatment considerations.
